arrive.text: You and your partner have been arrested. They've put you in separate rooms.

deal.text: The deal. If you talk and your partner stays silent, you walk free, and they get three years.

deal_2.text: If you both stay silent, one year each. If you both talk, two years each.

ask.text: You can't know what your partner will do. So what do you do?

glass.text: Through the glass, your partner. They can't see you. They're thinking exactly what you're thinking.

r_cc.text: You both stayed silent. One year each.

r_dc.text: You talked. Your partner didn't. You walk free, and they get three years.

r_cd.text: You stayed silent. Your partner talked. Three years for you.

r_dd.text: You both talked. Two years each.

again.text: A year later, you're both picked up again. Same rooms, same deal.

again_2.text: And again. Same rooms, same deal.

remember.text: This time, your partner remembers what you did.

end_coop.text: Whatever the other does, talking is always better for you alone. And yet, trusting each other left you both better off.

end_defect.text: Each of you did the sensible thing, every time. Together, you did worse than if you'd both kept quiet.

end_mixed.text: Your partner simply did whatever you did last time. Played again and again, being kind, but not a pushover, tends to do well.
